name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the bar over your mid-foot, then hinge until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Lower the bar back to the floor and reset between reps.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A strict barbell row where each rep starts from a dead stop on the floor.

safetyNotes: Use a flat back and a manageable load; stop if your back rounds.
